parts.text: The bank must obey its customer's instructions, and not those of anyone else. obey instructions 遵守命令 When , for example, a customer first opens an account, he instructs the bank to debit his account only in respect of cheques drawn by himself. in respect of 关于;至于（正式，常用于商务、法律或官方文件） He gives the bank specimens of his signature, and there is a very firm rule that the bank has no right or authority to pay out a customer's money on a cheque on which its customer's signature has been forged . signature 署名；签名；信号 authority 职权，权限 right to act in a specific way pay out 支付（大笔的钱） It makes no difference that the forgery may have been a very skillful one : the bank must recognize its customer's signature. make a difference 有用；有影响 For this reason there is no risk to the customer in the practice, adopted by banks, of printing the customer's name on his cheques. For this reason 因此（近义词组） risk of vs. risk to 做某事的风险 vs. 对某事的风险 the practice of doing sth. 做某事的惯例 If this facilitates forgery, it is the bank which will lose , not the customer. 强调句(科技、说明) facilitate... 使某事更容易(促进) It is... which... 特殊强调句（尤其用于科技、说明文体） if..., it is... that/which/who(m)..., not... 如果...，那么是...，而不是...（课文句型提炼）
The bank must obey its customer's instructions遵守其客户的指令.
All staff are required to strictly obey instructions严格遵守指令.
The system will only function if you obey all instructions遵守所有指令.

headers: with respect to 关于；至于（正式，比 in respect of 稍常见）

respecting 关于；就...而言（正式，比 in respect of 更不常用）

headers: for this reason 因此；由于这个原因（中性，书面和口语均可）
thus 因此；从而（正式，常用于书面语或学术写作，强调逻辑推理或结果）
therefore 因此；所以（正式，最常用的表示推论的词）
ergo 因此；所以（拉丁语，极正式，带有哲学或幽默色彩）
as a result 结果；因此（中性，强调直接的、可见的结果）
as a consequence 作为结果；因此（比 as a result 略正式，强调后果）
so 所以；因此（最常用，口语化，非正式）
hence 因此；由此（正式，常用于书面语，强调紧接的推论）
thereupon 随后；因此（正式，强调紧接着发生，或作为前述行动的结果）
accordingly 因此；相应地；照着（强调根据前述信息或情况采取相应的行动或得出结论）
consequently 结果；因此（正式，强调逻辑上或自然而然的结果）
in consequence 结果；因此（正式，与 as a consequence 相似）
rows: The data was incomplete; for this reason, the study results are inconclusive. 数据不完整；因此，研究结果不具结论性。
The evidence supported the initial hypothesis, thus confirming the theory. 证据支持了最初的假设，从而证实了该理论。

I think, ergo I am. (Cogito, ergo sum.) 我思故我在。
The flood damaged the crops, and as a result, food prices have increased. 洪水损坏了庄稼，结果食品价格上涨了。
He was frequently late, and as a consequence, he was eventually fired. 他经常迟到，因此，他最终被解雇了。
It started raining heavily, so we cancelled the picnic. 开始下大雨了，所以我们取消了野餐。
The device works wirelessly, hence the name "Cordless Speaker." 该设备是无线工作的，因此得名“无绳扬声器”。
The bell rang, and thereupon, the students rose from their seats. 铃声响了，随后学生们从座位上站起来。
The instructions were clear; we proceeded accordingly. 指示很清楚；我们照此进行。
The company lost its major contract; consequently, it had to reduce staff. 公司失去了主要合同；结果，不得不裁员。
The power grid failed, and in consequence, the whole city was blacked out. 电网瘫痪了，结果整个城市都停电了。
